title: Deciphering the binding mechanism of tafamidis to calf thymus DNA: multimodal spectroscopic, thermodynamic, and computational perspectives
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,28937-28948
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04723D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Manal A. Alossaimi, Heba Elmansi, Fathalla Belal, Galal Magdy
This work introduces the first study on the binding interaction between tafamidis and calf thymus DNA using multi-spectroscopic, viscosity, ionic strength, thermodynamic, molecular docking, and molecular dynamic simulation approaches.
